changelog:
- Initial release of remove-ai-writing-signs skill.
- Detects and eliminates signs of AI-generated English writing to produce genuinely human-like text.
- Uses a structured 5-pass rewriting process: artifact removal, era-aware vocabulary detox, content deflation, structural reconstruction, and texture injection.
- Covers 27 AI pattern families based on Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing.
- Includes calibration step to preserve original genre, style, and register; reduces over-correction risk.
- Supersedes "humanizer" skill when both are applicable.
